# Separator

Separator is a component of `@kozmos-ds/react` whose docs do not describe it yet.

- **Import:** `import { Separator } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Data Display
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/data-display-separator--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import { Separator, ThemeProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function SeparatorExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <div className="space-y-1">
        <h4 className="text-sm font-medium leading-none">Radix Primitives</h4>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          An open-source UI component library.
        </p>
        <Separator className="my-4" />
        <div className="flex h-5 items-center space-x-4 text-sm">
          <div>Blog</div>
          <Separator orientation="vertical" />
          <div>Docs</div>
          <Separator orientation="vertical" />
          <div>Source</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## Separator

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `Omit<SeparatorPrimitive.SeparatorProps & React.RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "ref">`.

- `asChild`: `boolean`, optional.
- `orientation`: `Orientation`, optional, default `'horizontal'`.

  Either `vertical` or `horizontal`. Defaults to `horizontal`.

- `decorative`: `boolean`, optional, default `true`.

  Whether or not the component is purely decorative. When true, accessibility-related attributes
  are updated so that that the rendered element is removed from the accessibility tree.

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).
